source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Double check the failed tests to ensure they were not experimental error.
3. Convert multiple pass/fail measurements into ratios: % fail, % pass.
4. Document the statistical significance of the failed tests.
5. Exceedance of specifications becomes an estimated occurrence rate and confidence interval.

## Step 1: start with the test records

You have the test records for each failure from your product performance report metric. You may need to separate out successful and failed tests. For example, in the ![](https://osf.io/27hw4/download) table below, two cars of three failed the crash test (2 out of 3 failures). Note I don't trust the numbers (the percentages don't add up), so I would contact the person who conducted this test to understand the data. Ideally, the original records include information on the driver, car, and any injuries based on the test, as well
